_comment: Phrases present in the old site that are deliberately absent from the new one. Each entry needs a reason. Matching is EXACT STRING EQUALITY after normalise()+lowercase against the whole missing phrase — not a substring. A partial or paraphrased entry will not suppress anything; it will silently do nothing and get reported as a stale entry instead. Copy the missing phrase's exact text out of the gate's own FAIL output verbatim.
/_reason: The old contact form (First name / Last name / Company / Work email / Message / Send message) posted to mailto:hello@manuva.app with method=POST, which most browsers either ignore, dump raw key=value text into a mail client from, or silently no-op on — shipping a form that can silently swallow a message is worse than not shipping one. Author's decision (task-7 ruling): keep the contact section's heading, copy and email details verbatim; drop the form and replace it with a direct mailto CTA. These six field-label/submit-button fragments are the form's only casualties.
/features_reason: The old page's Floor board feature (#production-planning) carries data-lucide="layout-kanban", which is not a real Lucide icon name in any version (checked lucide-static@0.544.0's full 1636-icon index and its tag list, not just the pinned build — no match, not even as a deprecated alias). lucide.createIcons() silently skips unrecognised names, so it renders as an empty, invisible icon on the live old site too — a bug in the source, not something this build is failing to port. Substituted the closest real, working glyph (kanban-square) for both that feature and the matching domain-grid tile. Team-lead ruling (task-9): authorised — nothing a reader can see is lost, the "lost" content is a broken icon reference.
/pricing_reason: The old page's entire mobile treatment for the feature matrix was this two-sentence note telling the reader to come back on a bigger screen (matrix-section is display:none below 720px with nothing standing in for it but this text). This build ships a real mobile fallback instead (.mv-matrix-cards, the old page's own KEEP-IN-SYNC plan-feats-mobile content, relocated into FeatureMatrix.astro) — so the instruction to leave and open a desktop is obsolete, not lost. Team-lead ruling (task-8): drop the note rather than keep it as a caption above a working mobile view, which would be actively contradictory.
/pricing: Open this page on desktop to see the full comparison matrix.
